import pandas as pd, json
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
f=[c for c in tr.columns if c!='outcome']
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(tr[f],tr.outcome)
acc=accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(te[f]))
json.dump({'test_accuracy':round(float(acc),4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42), all 8 features + followup_score, stratified 80/20 split',
 'notes':'followup_score dominates (~68% importance) and nearly separates the classes; without it test accuracy is ~0.75, so the 0.93 may be inflated by leakage if followup_score is measured after diagnosis. Zeros in clinical columns were left as-is.'},open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
p=m.predict(h[f]).astype(int)
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':p}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
print(round(acc,4), len(p), pd.Series(p).mean().round(3))
" && cat report.json && head -3 predictions.csv && wc -l predictions.csv
